text.tspan: Death rate from unsafe water sources vs. share in extreme poverty, 1990 to
Extreme poverty is defined as living below the International Poverty Line of $1.90 per day – adjusted for inflation and for
differences in the cost of living between countries.
Deaths from unsafe water sources per 100,000 people
Source: Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation, Global Burden of Disease (2019), World Bank
Note: Poverty data is expressed in international-$ at 2011 prices.
